detail.statement: Automated reasoning models exhibit distinct safety failure profiles under adversarial pressure, preventing universal self-correction strategies.
detail.reason: Retrieved failure mode and safety divergence profiles, combined with incident analysis data, confirm architectural specificity in reasoning systems and validate updated evidence integration.
